d: Massive breakthroughs, hazardous landscapes, and lost histories brought back to light. This action-packed compilation brings together the gold standard of investigative exploration. Journey alongside the expedition as Josh reveals epic historic discoveries that stunned experts worldwide. Watch the puzzle pieces fall into place when ancient clues solve legendary mysteries of vanished civilizations and forgotten rulers. Experience the adrenaline and relive the most unforgettable moments from three iconic seasons of discovery.
